metadata.description: Boost your AI agents with powerful tools. Skills, agents, and workflows for supercharging AI-assisted development — plus production-quality code-quality skills for clean code, testing, debugging, security, DevOps, and PR review.

plugins.name: obsidian-knowledge-graph
plugins.description: Turn Obsidian into an AI-managed knowledge graph. Captures architecture decisions, bug investigations, and codebase patterns as persistent memory across coding sessions.

plugins.name: ship-agent-context
plugins.description: In-repo memory for AI agents. Captures plans, decisions, in-flight status, standing user instructions, open questions, and incident scars in docs/agent/ so the next agent (or human) walks into context, not a blank slate.

plugins.name: ship-better-plans
plugins.description: Produce bulletproof, fully-specified, audited implementation plans. Structured intake, automatic docs/agent + codebase discovery, scored tradeoffs, numbered specs with edge cases, a parallelizable task DAG with subagent delegation, and a multi-persona Workflow audit (adversarial/pragmatist/production) before the plan is written to docs/agent/plans/.

plugins.name: ship-execute
plugins.description: Execute a written implementation plan with a fleet of expert subagents. Runs the plan's task DAG (parallel where independent, worktree-isolated), validates every step with real evidence (build + tests + acceptance criteria), vets the whole result via ship-reviewed-prs, then hands off for review or PR. Delegates coding depth to the ship-code skills.

plugins.name: ship-clean-code
plugins.description: Apply clean code principles when writing or reviewing production-quality Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Java code. Covers naming, functions, classes, error handling, testing, formatting, and 66 cataloged code smells.

plugins.name: ship-tested-code
plugins.description: Apply testing best practices when writing or reviewing tests for Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Java code. Covers test design, TDD, test strategy, mocking, integration testing, flaky test management, and 49 cataloged test smells.

plugins.name: ship-debugged-code
plugins.description: Apply systematic debugging practices when investigating, isolating, or fixing bugs in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Java code. Covers reproduction, hypothesis-driven investigation, bisection, root-cause analysis, observability, regression-test design, and postmortems.

plugins.name: ship-reviewed-prs
plugins.description: Multi-persona pull-request review (senior engineer, senior security, senior infra/SRE/DevOps, senior data engineer, senior frontend engineer, test-coverage signal) with comment-lifecycle suppression and decisive APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES/COMMENT submission. Runs locally with confirmation gating and in CI fully automated. Composes with the other ship-* skills via delegation: SC → ship-secure-code, IN → ship-devops, SE → ship-clean-code, TS → ship-tested-code.

plugins.name: ship-secure-code
plugins.description: Application-security review (SEC1-SEC12: auth, input validation, injection, XSS, CSRF/origin, crypto, secrets, supply chain, PII/logging, resource exhaustion, path traversal, deserialization/SSRF) for Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and Java. Sibling to ship-clean-code; serves as the depth target when ship-reviewed-prs SC persona delegates.

plugins.name: ship-devops
plugins.description: DevOps and CI/CD review (DEV1-DEV12: CI pipelines, deployment safety, IaC immutability, container images, secrets/config sourcing, observability, release management, schema migrations, health/readiness, SLO/performance, incident hygiene, and flow/batch signals). Sibling to ship-secure-code; serves as the depth target when the ship-reviewed-prs IN (Senior Infra / SRE / DevOps) persona delegates.

plugins.name: ship-vuln-scan
plugins.description: Detect known CVEs and supply-chain vulnerabilities across dependencies (SCA), container images, IaC, and secrets. Hybrid execution: orchestrates real scanners (osv-scanner, trivy, grype, pip-audit, npm/pnpm/yarn audit, checkov, gitleaks, syft) when present and falls back to manual lockfile/advisory analysis when absent — always recording scan provenance and a coverage flag so 'couldn't scan' is never reported as 'clean'. Triages by CVSS+EPSS+KEV+reachability (VS1-VS8) and emits a normalized findings artifact. Sibling ship-vuln-fix remediates what it finds; ship-reviewed-prs SC persona delegates here on lockfile/manifest changes.

plugins.name: ship-vuln-fix
plugins.description: Remediate the CVEs that ship-vuln-scan finds. Recipe-first + tiered + evidence-gated: prefers proven remediation recipes/tools (OpenRewrite/Moderne, npm/pip native fixers, Dependabot compatibility scores) and falls back to manual minimal edits, then auto-applies only mechanical, reversible fixes behind a confirmation gate and verifies them by re-scan + build/tests + a clean frozen install; advises only (exact plan, never edits) for breaking/major upgrades, code-level mitigations, and no-fix cases (VF1-VF8). The apply decision is driven by evidence (reviewed changelog/recipe, no new install scripts, green tests), never the semver delta. Every auto-apply emits a remediation audit record to docs/security/vuln-remediation/. Sibling ship-vuln-scan detects and verifies closure.
